name: Myntra SJIT
shortInfo: Myntra SJIT (Just-in-Time) is a business model Myntra uses for B2B2C transactions.
brief: Myntra raises purchase orders to brands, and these orders are reflected as sales orders in their system. Myntra then manages the order fulfillment, including shipping, on behalf of the brands.
about:
The Myntra SJIT connector assists sellers in maintainance of healthy stock levels, order management, returns management and more.

DataChannel’s Myntra SJIT Connector enables streaming relevant Myntra SJIT data into a user determined warehouse to enable users manage orders, customer returns, inventory and much more.
